text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor m-e-r-g-e-d the b-i-d-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s into one a-r-c-h-i-v-e and l-e-f-t a c-o-n-s-o-l-i-d-a-t-e-d f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w of the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
2) the p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e was r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d in a s-h-a-r-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t and the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l d-r-a-f-t-s w-e-r-e d-e-l-e-t-e-d w-i-t-h-o-u-t v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g the s-t-o-r-a-g-e l-o-c-k.
3) the c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e c-o-n-c-e-r-n-s were d-i-s-c-u-s-s-e-d in m-e-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s and the s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e p-a-g-e was s-a-v-e-d as a p-d-f w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-e-p.
4) the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-i-n-g s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e was f-o-r-m-a-t-t-e-d in the t-e-n-d-e-r p-r-o-p-o-s-a-l and the a-n-n-e-x t-a-b-l-e was i-n-c-l-u-d-e-d w-h-i-l-e o-m-i-t-t-i-n-g the d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-l-a-u-s-e.
5) the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g was e-x-p-o-r-t-e-d to the c-l-o-u-d d-r-i-v-e and the f-i-l-e n-a-m-e was r-e-n-a-m-e-d to "r-e-p-o-r-t" w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a c-l-e-a-n-s-e-p.
